Alex P: Quick heads-up — Bosch HW + LangChain gateway sandbox co-announce. Want a small joint launch: marketplace listing, sandbox access, and a short tech note. Targeting Tue next week. Who can own the deck + integration checklist?
Mira L: I can own the deck. I'll draft slides + one-pager. Need a short demo flow and any perf numbers.
Ian D: I'll do the integration checklist and verify gateway adapter compatibility. FYI one smoke test failing on batch API (KV cache mismatch).
Ian D: failing log snippet: `E0101 12:34:56 adapter.go:123] kvcache: expected 64 got 0`
Sasha M: I'll handle PR/comms and partner quote. Can we get a short partner quote from Bosch legal? Also need embargo window. :eyes:
Alex P: Good. Embargo: recommend 48h before marketplace publish. Is that OK with Bosch? @Sasha M can you handle?
Mira L: For assets: need Bosch logo (SVG), LangChain logo guidelines, and a 60s demo script. Will also put a 'what works/limitations' slide.
Ian D: Quick sample call I'll add to the tech note:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/gateway-lc-v1","input":"summarize:...","mode":"sandbox"}'
```
Ian D: Also will add matrix: supported models, quantizations, expected latency (p50/p95) per batch size. Need HW perf from Bosch — @Alex P can you ping them?
AnnounceBot: Draft deck created: https://drive.google.com/d/abcd1234 (view only) :robot_face:
Sasha M: I'll request partner quote and confirm embargo. Also prepping a short blog + release checklist. Can we aim to finalize deck by EOD Monday?
Alex P: EOD Monday works. Sync 3pm today to align on demo script + perf asks. Mira to send calendar invite. Thanks! :thumbsup:
